reviews.author: Benjamin Coddington
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Benjamin Coddington noted that the default value of output_Roles should be off to prevent adding 'open list:NFS-UTILS' onto email display names when using b4 workflows, and suggested setting it to off by default.

The reviewer noted that the get_maintainer.pl script incorrectly finds the top of the current working directory's git tree instead of its own location, and suggested changing the code to always use the script's location.
reviews.raw_body:
^^ output_Roles should default to off because otherwise using this with
b4 mangles adds that "open list:NFS-UTILS" onto the list's email display
name:

b4 prep --auto-to-cc
Collecting To/Cc addresses
    + To: Steve Dickson <steved@redhat.com>
    + Cc: open list:NFS-UTILS <linux-nfs@vger.kernel.org>

---

This finds the top of whatever git tree the cwd is in, not the tree
the script lives in.  Running it from a kernel tree:

  $ cd linux
  $ ~/nfs-utils/scripts/get_maintainer.pl -f fs/nfsd/export.c

reads the kernel's MAINTAINERS and prints the knfsd maintainers.

The fallback also leaves "scripts/.." in $topdir, so the -f prefix
strip never matches an absolute path when run from a tarball.

Maybe just always use the script's location:

        return abs_path(dirname(abs_path($0)) . '/..');

b4 runs it from the tree top, so that wouldn't change anything there.

Ben

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the NFS-utils codebase, specifically related to netlink usage and bug fixes. It ensures that mountd uses netlink when available, rather than falling back to /proc. The patches also include various cleanups, bugfixes, and improvements to the exportfs and nfsref functionality. Additionally, a new MAINTAINERS file is added to facilitate maintenance of the codebase.
